body.html: Who Caza V1 Serviced Apartment is for — to put it as simply as possible, Caza V1 Serviced Apartment is a place for people who want "a clean room in central Rayong on a budget" rather than a luxury beachfront resort where you come to relax and watch the waves · it isn't a beachfront stay where you wake up to the sea, and it isn't a high-rise hotel with a fancy rooftop pool, but a small serviced apartment of about 50 rooms designed to be comfortable for both a single night and a long stay — clean rooms, a private balcony, a mini-fridge, a 32-inch flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi · from the real reviews, the best-suited groups are people working or doing business in Rayong for several days, engineers and staff posted at the industrial estates around Rayong, travelers driving through the east who want a clean bed in town, and people who want a stay within walking distance of the night market to grab food in the evening · another group who say it's good value are people who drive themselves, because there's free parking and an EV charger, which is hard to find at a small in-town property · the place is rated 3 stars by the booking platforms, but the real selling point isn't the star count — it's the cleanliness of the rooms, the central location, and the warm service at a price you can actually reach · it's still open and operating as usual, and it carries a high review score of 9.2 on Trip.com that consistently shows it as a good-value stay guests are happy with in Rayong

Location and getting around — Caza V1 is at 8 Klongkhud Alley, Sukhumvit Road, Tha Pradu, Mueang Rayong, a zone that's in central Rayong, about 1 km from the town center · the highlight reviews mention most is that it's a few minutes' walk to Star Night Bazaar and Wat Rong, while Wat Pa Pradu, an important temple of the town, is about 1 km away · the property sits right on Sukhumvit Road, a main route, which makes driving anywhere easy — a few minutes to markets, restaurants, petrol stations and convenience stores, and Si Mueang Golf Course is about a 5 min drive · for those who want to head to the sea, Sang Chan Beach is about a 10 min drive, and Mae Ramphueng Beach and Ban Phe Pier (for the boat to Koh Samet) are also a short drive away · for longer trips, the hotel is about a 50 min drive from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), and from Bangkok it's about a 2.5–3 hr drive via the motorway · the upside many reviews agree on is that you can genuinely walk to food and the market here, unlike many places in Rayong where you have to drive a long way out · another piece of good news is parking — there's free parking and an EV charger, which matters to people who drive themselves

"Very clean room, and the front-desk staff were friendly and helpful · great location, an easy walk to the Star Night Bazaar night market, plenty of food nearby · I was in Rayong for work for several days and it felt very convenient, with free parking too"

Room types and decor — Caza V1 has about 50 rooms, mainly Standard Double Room (one large bed), Deluxe Double Studio (a queen bed, a wider studio room) and Standard Triple Room (one queen + one single, for three people or a small family) · the main selling point is the cleanliness of the rooms, which real reviews consistently praise as "spotless", a key reason the overall score climbs to 9.2 · most rooms have a private balcony looking out over the surrounding area or a garden, which feels airier and gives more breathing room than a same-priced hotel room with no balcony · the rooms are decorated in bright tones with a little color, look clean and tidy, and have a fairly generous amount of space for a serviced apartment at this level · every room has air conditioning, a 32-inch flat-screen TV, a mini-fridge, hot water and free Wi-Fi, which suits a longer stay · to be straight about it, this is a small 3-star property, so it doesn't have large suites or luxe design, and there's no full kitchen in the room (there's a shared communal kitchen to use instead) — a detail worth setting expectations on, that the selling point is cleanliness and location, not luxury · if you want a wider room with a clear seating area, choose the Deluxe Double Studio when you book

Facilities, gym and massage room — even though it's a small place, Caza V1 has more facilities than many people expect at this price · there's a gym for guests to work out without heading outside to find one, which matters to long-stay guests · there's a massage room/spa to relax after traveling or a full day's work · what many reviews praise in particular is the free parking and EV charger, which is very hard to find at a small in-town property, ideal for people driving an EV around the east · on top of that there's a full set of services for long stays: a shuttle service, a taxi-calling service, laundry service and coin-operated washing machines, luggage storage, car rental, and a shared communal kitchen for guests to reheat food or cook something simple · there's 24-hour security · to be straight about it, there's a note from the real reviews that there's no swimming pool here and not much greenery or outdoor relaxation space, because it's an in-town building · if you mainly want a pool, you'll need to consider somewhere else, but if your focus is cleanliness and location, the facilities here are genuinely usable and good value

Food and the V1 Kitchen restaurant — breakfast is a point Caza V1 earns praise for in many reviews · the in-house restaurant, V1 Kitchen, serves mainly Thai food, with an international breakfast for guests · what real reviews mention especially is the breakfast coupon system that's flexible about timing — instead of fixing a set buffet breakfast time, here you get a coupon you can use whenever it suits you, which is great for people who get up early for work or have an unpredictable schedule · reviews describe the breakfast as "tasty" and the restaurant as clean and tidy · for long-stay guests, having an in-house restaurant plus the shared communal kitchen helps a lot on days you don't want to go anywhere · to be straight about it, there's a note from reviews that the breakfast menu is fairly limited in choice, not as varied as a big hotel, and room service only runs at certain times · the good news is the central location makes it very easy to walk out for food at Star Night Bazaar or restaurants in the area within a few minutes, so it isn't a big problem for people who like heading out for food themselves

Service — service at Caza V1 is a point that earns praise overall from real reviews, especially the front-desk staff, described as friendly, helpful and warm, which matters a lot for a serviced apartment with long-stay guests, because the relationship with the team affects how much it feels like home · there's a full set of services for long stays — shuttle, taxi-calling, laundry and luggage storage — which puts frequent travelers or people with unpredictable schedules more at ease · to be straight about it, there are two notes from the real reviews — one is that some reviews felt the restaurant staff seemed cooler than the front-desk staff, a contrast that comes through clearly in some reviews, and two is noise from a nearby car-wash activity at certain times · there are also reviews saying the Wi-Fi signal is inconsistent in some spots · overall, service is still a strong point here and lines up with the consistently high 9.2 score

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulled together from Trip.com and TripAdvisor, the picture is fairly consistent · on the praise side: very clean rooms, "spotless"; friendly, helpful front-desk service; a central location within walking distance of Star Night Bazaar and restaurants; tasty breakfast with a flexible coupon system; rooms with private balconies; free parking and an EV charger; and overall value compared with prices that start in the high hundreds · on the gripes side: what comes up is inconsistent Wi-Fi signal in some spots, a fairly limited breakfast menu, restaurant staff who seem cooler than the front desk, noise from a nearby car wash at certain times, and no pool or outdoor greenery · most of these gripes are matters of "setting your expectations right" for a small 3-star in-town property rather than big problems — you can see that in the overall 9.2 score on Trip.com and the TripAdvisor ranking of #7 of 57 specialty lodging properties in Rayong, which puts it near the top

"The breakfast was tasty, and I liked the coupon system — you choose your own time, no rush · the room was very clean, with a balcony to sit out on · the only gripe is the Wi-Fi signal isn't very steady at times, but overall it's great value for an in-town stay"

Price comparison and value — Caza V1's starting price is about THB 600/night in the budget range for a Standard room, and averages around THB 900–1,200/night in the normal range for the wider studio room · what makes it especially good value is booking by the month, where the per-night price drops a lot compared with daily, which suits workers who need to stay in Rayong long-term and is the reason many people pick it as a regular base · compared with hotels in Rayong like Holiday Inn & Suites Rayong City Centre, which starts around THB 1,800/night, or Kameo Grand Rayong, which sits at a higher tier, Caza V1 feels very good value in the budget group, especially counting that you get a clean room with a balcony in town plus free parking for under half the price · if you measure value by "cleanliness per baht" and "a location you can walk to food from," it scores very well here · but if you measure by "swimming pool," "sea view" or "room luxury," you have to accept you'll need to look at a higher-tier property or the beach side instead

Good to know before booking — there are a few things that help the stay go more smoothly · one, this is a small in-town place within walking distance of the market and restaurants, ideal for people who like heading out for food themselves, but there's no pool, so if you want one, choose somewhere else · two, if you want a wider room with a clear seating area, choose the Deluxe Double Studio when you book, and for three people choose the Triple Room · three, if you plan a long stay of several weeks or more, ask about the monthly rate directly with the property — it's usually much better value than booking daily · four, if you work online and need heavy internet, have a backup plan (such as mobile data) ready, because there are reviews saying the Wi-Fi is inconsistent in some spots · five, if you drive an EV, there's a charger here to use, which is an advantage, but you should ask about the queue and conditions in advance · six, choose free cancellation first if your plans aren't settled, because accommodation prices in Rayong shift with festival periods and long weekends · seven, if possible, ask for a room not on the side with the car-wash activity to cut down on noise at certain times

Bottom line — from all the real reviews, Caza V1 Serviced Apartment is the best fit for people who want a clean room in central Rayong within walking distance of the market and restaurants, on a reachable budget · spotless rooms, a private balcony, good front-desk service, a praised breakfast with a flexible coupon system, free parking with an EV charger, and bookable both daily and monthly make it a good-value choice for people coming to work, staying long-term, or travelers driving through the east · if you're looking for a beachfront resort where you wake up to the sea, or a stay with a swimming pool and wide green space, this may not be the answer, and you should consider the Mae Ramphueng Beach side, Koh Samet, or a resort with a pool instead · but for a stay focused on cleanliness, a central location within walking distance of food, and value — Caza V1 answers that need well, and it's the reason the 9.2 score on Trip.com stays consistently high

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Caza V1 Serviced Apartment Rayong

faq.q: Where is Caza V1 Serviced Apartment · how do you get there?
faq.a: The property is at 8 Klongkhud Alley, Sukhumvit Road, Tha Pradu, Mueang Rayong, in central Rayong, about 1 km from the town center · the highlight is that it's a few minutes' walk to Star Night Bazaar and Wat Rong, with Wat Pa Pradu about 1 km away · Sang Chan Beach is about a 10 min drive and Si Mueang Golf Course about a 5 min drive · it's about a 50 min drive from U-Tapao Airport (UTP), and from Bangkok about a 2.5–3 hr drive

faq.q: What are the rooms at Caza V1 like · do they have balconies?
faq.a: There are about 50 rooms in Standard Double, Standard Triple and Deluxe Double Studio · the highlight is that the rooms are very clean and many have a private balcony, with a mini-fridge, a 32-inch flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi · it's a small 3-star place with no full kitchen in the room (there's a shared communal kitchen to use instead) · if you want a wider room, choose the Deluxe Double Studio

faq.q: What's the starting price at Caza V1 · can you book monthly?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 600/night for a Standard room in the budget range, and average around THB 900–1,200/night for the wider studio room · monthly booking is available, and the monthly rate is much better value than booking daily, which suits people coming to work or staying long-term in Rayong · you should compare several platforms and ask the property directly about the monthly rate

faq.q: Who is Caza V1 best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for people working or doing business in Rayong for several days, travelers driving through the east, and people who want a clean in-town stay within walking distance of the market and restaurants · you get a clean room with a balcony on a reachable budget, plus free parking and an EV charger · if you're looking for a beachfront resort with a sea view, or a stay with a swimming pool, the Mae Ramphueng Beach side or a resort with a pool may suit you better

faq.q: Does Caza V1 have a swimming pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There's no swimming pool because it's a small in-town place, but there is a gym and a massage room/spa to use · breakfast is at the V1 Kitchen restaurant serving Thai and international food, and what reviews praise is the breakfast coupon system that's flexible about timing, usable whenever it suits you · the note is that the menu is fairly limited in choice

faq.q: What's Caza V1 Serviced Apartment's review score?
faq.a: It scores 9.2 from 112 reviews on Trip.com and 4 out of 5 on TripAdvisor, ranked #7 of 57 specialty lodging properties in Rayong · the numbers consistently show it as a serviced apartment guests are very happy with, especially for room cleanliness, front-desk service, the central location, breakfast and value
